units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:15">Ab. II, 15</cite> <he>היום ק׳ וכ׳</he> the day (of life) is short, and the work large.
Y. Pes. VII, 35ᵇ bot. ילך לו בק׳ let him take the shortest road to it; a. fr.—Fem. קְצָרָה. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassʿa, s. 1 תפילת הצדיקים ק׳ the prayer of the pious is short.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:4">Ber. I, 4</cite> <he>אחת … ואחת ק׳</he> one lengthy and one short benediction.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 4:2">Ib. IV, 2</cite> <he>היה … תפלה ק׳</he> used to say a short prayer on entering and on leaving the school-house.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 2:5:3">Y. Hor. II, 46ᵈ</cite> top <he>בא לו … בק׳</he> if he came by the shortest road; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 53:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. LIII</cite> <he>ע״י שהיתה ידו ק׳ במצות</he> because his hand was short (he was wanting) in good deeds; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 769:1">Yalk. ib. 769</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 135:1">Yalk. Sam. 135</cite> <he>נפשו ק׳</he>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="S01852"><he>קְצָרִים</he></cite>; <cite ref="S01851"><he>קְצָרוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:2:6">Cant. R. to VI, 2</cite> <he>ארוכות וק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A03026"><he>אָרוּךְ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 68">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXVIII</cite>, <he>ולא היו קִצְרֵי יד בו</he> they were not short-handed with it, i.e. they did not have to economize.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:24">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 81</cite> <he>אתה ארך אפים ואנו קְצֵירֵי רוח</he> thou art long-suffering, but we are hasty of spirit; a. e.—V. <cite ref="S01850"><he>קְצָרָה</he></cite>.
